rawContent: Wishing all the best and in solidarity with Priya Ramani for today's verdict #MeToo

You might think nothing changed, but more and more women speaking out about sexual harassment after the #MeToo movement has had visible trickle down effects in workplaces. Employers can't claim ignorance anymore. There is a certain level of awareness. Of course this is change is-

At great personal risk of being doxxed, harassed further or being sued for speaking out, survivors often have to go through so much in the background for these changes to come about. Today is a good day to look back at everything they've done and be grateful #MeToo

Tw: abuse, harassment

Despite having worked on dozens of cases of abuse for a couple of years now, it still is triggering and disabling on a personal level. 
This is for all those women who've silently dealt with personal trauma while looking out and helping other women. #MeToo
Reading the judgment and writing about is making me feel so many emotions. It's been a long time coming #PriyaRamani #MeToo

In today's @vervemagazine archives, a look back at my piece about the future of the #metoo movement from 2018. How far have we come?
